mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE phone = #{phone} AND deleted = 0
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND ur.deleted = 0

SELECT r.id, r.role_name as name, r.role_code as code, r.description, CASE WHEN r.status = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END as status, r.create_time as createdAt, r.update_time as updatedAt FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND ur.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.sort ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 AND rp.deleted = 0 AND ur.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = #{loginTime}, last_login_ip = #{loginIp}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE sys_user SET password_error_count = #{errorCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE sys_user SET locked = 1, lock_time = #{lockTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE sys_user SET locked = 0, lock_time = NULL, password_error_count = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
